opening.comment: The greeting gave only the company name; the agent did not state their own name as required.

verification.quote: Agent: Can I have your full name and order number or postcode?
verification.comment: The agent correctly asked for full name and order number before discussing the order, and the caller supplied both.

understanding.quote: Agent: So you're asking when the €15.00 comes back?
understanding.comment: The agent captured the refund issue, though the transcript is garbled and the agent did not clearly confirm the return details the caller gave.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Agent: Refunds take 10 to 14 working days after we receive the item, so it'll be another week or two.
resolution_accuracy.comment: Policy says refunds are paid within 5 working days of the return arriving at the warehouse, so the stated 10 to 14 days is wrong and the amount quoted (€15.00 vs €75.00) is inconsistent.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: Refunds take 10 to 14 working days after we receive the item, so it'll be another week or two.
process_compliance.comment: No hold occurred, so the hold step does not apply; the return-related steps were not clearly followed, but the main failure is the incorrect timeline already scored under resolution accuracy.

communication.quote: Customer: I'm getting a bit worried.
communication.comment: The agent acknowledged the caller's worry with 'I understand, it's worrying when money is outstanding', which was polite and appropriate.

closing.quote: Agent: Thanks for calling, ahmad, have a good afternoon.
closing.comment: The agent asked if there was anything else and closed politely, though confirming the next step was done with an incorrect timeline.
